entity.summary: Active centralized cryptocurrency exchange and trading-bot platform that emerged from the Pionex.US regional service through a reviewed 2025 brand transition to Webot, with current US and EU operating entities under the Webot brand.
entity.notes: Apple App Store release history dates the Pionex.US app's Webot 2.0 rebrand to 2025-12-02. Pionex.US first-party help material describes Webot as the official brand upgrade of Pionex.US and documents continuity of credentials, funds, positions, trading history and referral codes. HEI does not set predecessor_id to the global Pionex entity hei_ex_000092 because the global Pionex exchange continues to operate and Pionex.US was a regional service surface rather than the terminal identity of the global exchange. Current US services identify Pionex Inc. of Delaware as the Webot operator; current EU services identify Pionew Ireland Limited trading as Webot. These regional operating entities remain one Webot exchange identity rather than count-inflating separate exchange records.

events.title: Webot identity launched through the Pionex.US brand transition
events.description: The Pionex.US mobile exchange released Webot 2.0 as a brand update, while first-party migration guidance documents continuity of existing user credentials, balances, positions and trading history into the Webot platform.
events.notes: This is the reviewed start marker for the Webot identity. It does not mean the still-active global Pionex exchange was rebranded or terminated.

evidence.title: Comprehensive Guide: Upgrading from Pionex.US to Webot
evidence.notes: First-party migration guidance states that Webot is the official brand upgrade of Pionex.US and that existing login credentials, funds, positions, trading history and referral codes were carried over.

evidence.title: Pionex.US / Webot App Store release history
evidence.notes: Version 2.0.1 dated 2025-12-02 announces WEBOT 2.0, explicitly says formerly Pionex.US, and describes the release as a rebrand to Webot.

evidence.title: Webot official exchange website
evidence.notes: Current first-party site exposes account creation, spot trading, conversion and built-in crypto trading-bot functions and identifies Webot as formerly Pionex.US.

evidence.title: Webot User Agreement
evidence.notes: Current US agreement identifies Pionex Inc., a Delaware company, as Webot and governs cryptocurrency services offered through webot.com and the corresponding application.

evidence.title: Webot EU Operating Rules for Trading Platform
evidence.notes: Current first-party EU operating rules identify Pionew Ireland Limited trading as Webot and describe regulated crypto-asset trading, custody and transfer services under MiCA.
